description: Opponent-time architecture comparison. Trace actions pN move a pawn to square N; wN place encoded wall N. Replay from each initial state with extension/rules.js. Superseded/abandoned records are separate from complete comparisons.

limitations: Finite paired games do not prove universal optimality or an Elo rating.
Preparation runs before opponent analysis, on the exact opponent-to-move board, without knowing the eventual move; serial phases remove local opponent-model CPU contention.
Each player gets the same fixed idle allowance and identical foreground budgets. Idle time is simulated rather than replaying live human response times.
Both players keep independent engine and model contexts throughout each game.
Unfinished games and repetition stops are reported separately, never counted as wins or draws.
